title: HackerRank - Online Coding Tests & Certified Assessments
text:
Technical Screening tool
Find the next-gen developer, fast
Take home assessments built for an AI-first world, so that you can quickly identify the best applicants in your funnel
Try for free
Book a demo
Build your hiring process to mirror the new job
The role of the developer is changing as almost every developer uses AI to build software. You gain a strategic advantage by finding developers embracing their new role as orchestrators of AI agents across the full software development life cycle.
With HackerRank you can screen for:
Fundamentals without AI
Use real-world projects to test the ability to effectively review code and debug issues
Ability to work with AI
A built-in AI Interviewer tests their ability to use AI tools throughout the SDLC
Knowledge of AI concepts
Measure understanding of prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases
The modern way of hiring the
next generation of developers
technical content for tests
Quickly identify top candidates by asking high quality questions
Skip the hassle of building tests from scratch and use a role-based Certified Assessment or upload a job description and have the system instantly create a unique test for you. Covering tech's most in-demand roles and skills, across all levels,
HackerRank has the largest library of developer hiring content in the world.
integrity built in
Invest in the integrity stack that's able to enforce your company's standards
Clearly establish expectations for when candidates can and can not use AI in your hiring process. Enforce those rules at scale with the world's leading integrity stack.
In HackerRank Screen you get:
a proprietary model to detect suspicious coding activity
a proctor to set instructions and intervene if necessary
a system that verifies candidates' identity and monitors for multiple faces taking the assessment
The future of hiring
Let AI conduct your screening
Designed to conduct first-round interviews like your best engineers, the interviewer evaluates depth of knowledge, problem-solving skills, code quality, and the ability to work with AI.
Gives hints without revealing the answer
Ramps up complexity with progressively harder questions
Provides a detailed report following the interview
